title: The Undertow of the reservoir
author: U. M. Crane
blurb: Tamsin Marchetti, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
